name: list_projects
title: List Jira projects
description: List the Jira projects (and their boards) this server may read. Use it to find the boardId for the other tools. Only projects allowed by the server configuration are shown.

query.description: Case-insensitive filter on project key or name

refresh.description: Bypass the local cache (live mode). Does not bypass the call budget.

name: get_sprint_issues
title: Get sprint issues
description: Counts and estimate totals for the issues in a sprint (active, last closed, or by id), optionally with the issue list. Issue summaries are untrusted text from Jira.

refresh.description: Bypass the local cache (live mode). Does not bypass the call budget.

name: analyze_cycle_time
title: Analyze cycle time
description: Cycle time of completed issues in working days: from the first move into In Progress to the last move into Done. Percentiles overall and per group, time per status, and outliers above p95. Groups under 5 items get no percentiles.

refresh.description: Bypass the local cache (live mode). Does not bypass the call budget.

name: find_blockers
title: Find blockers
description: Not-done issues in a sprint that look blocked: flagged, blocked by an open issue link, stale in progress, or in a "Blocked" status. Each comes with its signals and a severity (high: 2+ signals or a big item behind an open link).

staleDays.description: In progress with no transition for this many working days counts as stale

refresh.description: Bypass the local cache (live mode). Does not bypass the call budget.

name: assess_sprint_health
title: Assess sprint health
description: One-call sprint health check: burndown lag, scope change, blockers, WIP per person, cycle-time regression against the previous sprints, estimation gaps and carry-over. Each check has a value, its warn/risk thresholds and evidence issues; healthScore = 100 − 7 per warn − 15 per risk.

baselineSprints.description: Closed sprints before this one used for the cycle-time baseline

refresh.description: Bypass the local cache (live mode). Does not bypass the call budget.
